## Checklist

- [ ] G0 reconciled against the exact branch and HEAD.
- [ ] Diff contains only approved files and behavior.
- [ ] Tests were defined before production changes.
- [ ] No retries concealed failures or intermittency.
- [ ] Full-suite failures are resolved and remain recorded.
- [ ] Risk Level 3 physical evidence matches exact HEAD.
- [ ] Independent review was performed by a new reviewer who did not modify files.
- [ ] No post-review change invalidated the verdict.
- [ ] Gate Card is current and names one next action.
